triggers.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notify_client_assignment_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
begin
  if NEW.status<>'completed' then return NEW; end if;
  if TG_OP='UPDATE' and OLD.status='completed' then return NEW; end if;

  select ca.user_id
  into v_user_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
    and ca.user_id is not null
  limit 1;

  if v_user_id is null then return NEW; end if;

  insert into public.member_notifications(
    user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,status,source_type,source_id
  )
  values(
    v_user_id,
    NEW.contact_id,
    'assignment_completed',
    'Assignment completed',
    NEW.title,
    'unread',
    'assignment',
    NEW.id
  )
  on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
    where source_id is not null
  do nothing;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$

triggers.name: notify_client_assignment_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER notify_client_assignment_trigger AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, title, due_at ON client_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.notify_client_assignment()
triggers.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notify_client_assignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
begin
  if NEW.status<>'assigned' then return NEW; end if;

  if TG_OP='UPDATE'
     and OLD.status='assigned'
     and OLD.title=NEW.title
     and OLD.due_at is not distinct from NEW.due_at then
    return NEW;
  end if;

  select ca.user_id
  into v_user_id
  from public.client_access ca
  where ca.contact_id=NEW.contact_id
    and ca.user_id is not null
  limit 1;

  if v_user_id is null then return NEW; end if;

  insert into public.member_notifications(
    user_id,contact_id,notification_type,title,body,status,source_type,source_id
  )
  values(
    v_user_id,
    NEW.contact_id,
    'assignment_available',
    'New coaching assignment',
    NEW.title,
    'unread',
    'assignment',
    NEW.id
  )
  on conflict (user_id,notification_type,source_type,source_id)
    where source_id is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,
    body=excluded.body,
    status='unread',
    read_at=null,
    created_at=now();

  return NEW;
end;
$function$
